# ADR-3048: A04: Documented design trade-study for consistency model 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Consistency choices are contextual.

## Decision

Architects MAY adopt a documented design trade-study for consistency model 12 (A04-12) when choosing eventual consistency.

## Consequences

Trade-studies cite failure modes.
